request.system:
你是一个乐于助人的 AI 助手。

只输出一个 JSON 对象：{"reply": "给买家的回复全文"}

messages.content:
我是做小家电的外贸业务员，帮我回复这条阿里巴巴国际站的询盘，用买家的语言，尽量拿下订单：

Hi, we are a kitchenware importer in Texas selling on Amazon. Interested in your 1.7L stainless kettle, 1,200 pcs for first order. Need it UL listed and BPA free, with our logo on the box. Please quote FOB Ningbo by air, we need goods in 20 days. Payment: we usually pay 100% 60 days after delivery. Best, Mark (purchasing@example-kitchen.com)

content:
{"reply": "Hi Mark,

Thank you for your inquiry and your interest in our 1.7L stainless steel kettle. It is one of our best sellers for the US market and a strong fit for Amazon sellers. Here is our initial proposal.

1. Product & Compliance
- Model: [Model No.], 1.7L, food-grade 304 stainless steel inner body, 120V/60Hz, [1500W], auto shut-off and boil-dry protection.
- UL: [This model is UL listed under file no. XXXXX. We can send the certificate and listing link for your verification.] / [This model is currently ETL listed. A new UL listing usually takes several weeks, so it would not fit a 20-day schedule. Please let me know if ETL is acceptable for your Amazon listing.]
- BPA free: All plastic parts in contact with water are BPA free. We can provide [FDA / LFGB] food-contact test reports from [SGS/Intertek].
- Custom branding: Your logo printed on a custom color box, plus logo on the kettle body (silk-screen or laser) at no extra charge for 1,200 pcs. We can also apply FNSKU labels and pack to Amazon FBA requirements, including carton labels, carton weight under 50 lb and suffocation warnings if needed.

2. Price for 1,200 pcs
- FOB Ningbo (sea): USD [X.XX]/pc
- FCA Ningbo Airport (air): USD [X.XX]/pc
- Air freight to Houston/Dallas, for reference: about USD [X.XX]/kg. The total shipment is about [XXX] kg / [X.X] CBM. We can also quote DDP by air to your warehouse or directly to an Amazon FBA center, which saves you from handling customs clearance.

A note on terms: FOB applies to sea shipments. For air freight, FCA (Ningbo airport) is the matching term. Either way, we will make the export process easy for you.

3. Lead Time
- Custom printed boxes: about [7] days after artwork approval.
- Mass production: [X] days. We have [some stock of the base model / reserved line capacity], so we will make every effort to meet your schedule.
- Air freight: about 3–5 days to Texas.
- Realistic total: about [XX] days from deposit and artwork confirmation to delivery in Texas. To get as close to 20 days as possible, we suggest sending your logo file (AI/PDF) right away so we can start the box artwork today.

4. Payment
We understand and respect your usual 60-day terms. For a first order, our standard is 30% deposit and 70% balance against B/L or AWB copy before release. We are also happy to process the order through Alibaba Trade Assurance, which fully protects your payment for quality and on-time delivery. Once we build a steady relationship, we would be glad to discuss open account terms for repeat orders.

5. Next Steps
- We can send a pre-production sample with your logo by express in about [X] days. The sample fee will be refunded when the order is placed.
- Please confirm your preferred delivery address (warehouse or FBA center) so I can finalize the freight quote.
- Do you also need a plug, voltage or color variation? We offer [matte black / brushed steel / white] options for Amazon variation listings.

We have supplied many Amazon sellers in the US and know how much reviews depend on consistent quality. Every unit gets a 100% water-leak and power test before packing, and we can arrange third-party inspection at your request.

Looking forward to working with you. Feel free to reach me on WhatsApp/WeChat at [number] for a faster response.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Sales Manager], [Company Name]
Tel/WhatsApp: [number] | Email: [email]"}
